div.div:
Why several zones? Each zone is a separate group of data centres with its own power, cooling and network, kilometres from the others. If one zone fails, the copies in the other zones keep the shop open.
Why IDs, not names? The friendly names (us-east-1a, 1b…) are shuffled differently in every AWS account. The ID use1-az1 means the same physical place for everyone, so this setup always lands where we expect.
